notes.title: Ver 1.02
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42339993/acf16beaf77da4783a98584426045ff51c08c7a6.png[/img]

Small changes on this patch:

- Hints now indicate when a building has no power.
- The hint that explained pipe length now appears on the bottom left corner (like the camera controls) instead of using the usual hint window.
- Pipes now change their opacity when they're too long.
- There's a new visual indicator (similar to turret range) to show pipe length threshold.

notes.title: Ver 1.01
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42339993/acf16beaf77da4783a98584426045ff51c08c7a6.png[/img]

Small changes on this patch:

- Camera control hints now stay on the screen until the player uses them.
- Fixed a bug that caused warehouses to work even if not powered.
- Adjusted the position of a few elements on the map.
- Added more versions of the end text.
- Fixed a small bug that would display a wrong cursor image on some occasions.

notes.title: Puzzle game collection CosmOS 9 is a gentle introduction to the genre
notes.notes:
A new collection of indie puzzle games released today aims to give a broad and gentle introduction to many puzzling subgenres. Wrapped up in that idea that they're all pulled from a mysterious alien games console, CosmOS 9 packs nine games that are each meant to take 30-90 minutes. I've played a few and they seemed puzzle game staples, having me drawing paths through blocks, figure out how a mysterious computer interface worked, and such. See the breadth of the cosmic puzzling experience in the trailer below.
